items.claim: CEO 描述新財年開局強勁，並稱各產品線、地區皆優於計畫
items.quote: It was a super strong start to the quarter, to the year.
items.speaker: George Kurian

items.claim: 全快閃陣列營收創紀錄、年增 47%
items.quote: All-flash array revenue was a record, up 47% year-on-year.
items.speaker: George Kurian

items.claim: 全年產品毛利率展望每季都比年初給的數字逐步上修
items.quote: product gross margins, it's incrementally up every quarter
items.speaker: George Kurian

items.claim: 產品毛利率靠提價轉嫁成本，管理層承認無法一對一完全轉嫁
items.quote: we can't match them always one for one
items.speaker: George Kurian

items.claim: 公司整體毛利率受產品與服務組合影響，產品成長遠快於服務
items.quote: product is growing much faster than service
items.speaker: George Kurian

items.claim: 產品毛利率比 90 天前的預期更好
items.quote: better than we thought 90 days ago
items.speaker: George Kurian

items.claim: AI 專屬配置與一般企業業務的毛利率結構無實質差異
items.quote: the margin profile, there's no material difference
items.speaker: George Kurian

items.claim: 被問到 NAND／硬碟供給與定價，管理層表示存貨增加是為了備足供給，並提到現貨與長約並用
items.quote: inventory was up because we want to make sure
items.speaker: George Kurian

items.claim: 向供應商採購方式包含公開市場與長期合約
items.quote: buying in the open market as well as through long-term
items.speaker: George Kurian

items.claim: 快閃成本升高下，磁碟式系統已開始出現成長
items.quote: our disk-based systems have started to show growth
items.speaker: George Kurian

items.claim: 管理層給出快閃與磁碟的成本倍數
items.quote: as the cost of flash becomes 15 to 20x the cost of disk
items.speaker: George Kurian

items.claim: Keystone（儲存即服務）Q1 表現高於內部目標
items.quote: were above our internal targets
items.speaker: George Kurian

items.claim: 預告在 INSIGHT 大會發布針對高階 neocloud 訓練場景的新進展
items.quote: We are going to be announcing even more advancements
items.speaker: George Kurian

items.claim: AFX 平台客戶需經認證流程
items.quote: They go through a certification process
items.speaker: George Kurian

items.claim: 對 neocloud 的銷售模式是夥伴多於供應商
items.quote: we are more partner than vendor
items.speaker: George Kurian

items.claim: 主權雲端：法國前八大雲端業者中六家以 NetApp 為基礎設施
items.quote: 6 of the 8 largest cloud providers in France have NetApp
items.speaker: George Kurian

items.claim: 面對全堆疊綑綁廠商，管理層稱與六個月前相比無根本改變
items.quote: No fundamental changes from 6 months ago.
items.speaker: George Kurian

items.claim: 管理層點名 NetApp、Pure、Dell 為持平或增加份額的專注型廠商
items.quote: it's probably us, Pure and Dell
items.speaker: George Kurian

items.claim: 美國公部門採購干擾已緩解
items.quote: the disruption from a procurement side has mitigated
items.speaker: George Kurian

items.claim: 公部門市場管理層稱是與 Dell 的兩強競爭
items.quote: it's a 2-horse race between us and Dell
items.speaker: George Kurian

items.claim: 公有雲長期以來維持高十位數到低二十位數成長
items.quote: public cloud has grown in the high teens, low 20s
items.speaker: George Kurian

items.claim: CEO 表示正在向銷售團隊施壓要求雲端更快成長
items.quote: I'm pushing for faster growth.
items.speaker: George Kurian

items.claim: 舉例：剛把一家大型競爭對手客戶的 AI 資料湖搬上公有雲
items.quote: moved a large competitive customer to the public cloud
items.speaker: George Kurian

items.claim: 銷售模式：不直接賣給超大型雲端業者，而是透過它們賣給企業
items.quote: We sell through them to the enterprise.
items.speaker: George Kurian

items.claim: 對儲存而言推論的重要性遠大於訓練
items.quote: inference is the much bigger part of the overall business
items.speaker: George Kurian

items.claim: 面對元件漲價，基礎設施升級需求高於正常型態
items.quote: We are seeing infrastructure upgrades way above normal
items.speaker: George Kurian

items.claim: 新use case 需求同樣高於正常型態
items.quote: We are seeing new use cases also way above normal pattern
items.speaker: George Kurian

items.claim: 內部 AI 專案由約 400 件收斂，其中 13 件已在損益表貢獻正報酬
items.quote: that are contributing to positive returns in the P&L
items.speaker: George Kurian

qa_flags.question: FY27 財測有多少 NAND／硬碟已由長約鎖定、多少要以浮動價採購，以及財測內含的元件價格假設
qa_flags.response_pattern: 未給長約占比或價格假設，改談需求可見度、供應商合作與存貨增加
